string-array.name: tut_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders, feet together.
Make one straight line from head to heels — squeeze glutes, tighten belly.
Lower until your chest is about a fist above the floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push the floor away back to the start.

string-array.name: tut_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging or sticking up
Elbows flaring straight out to the sides

resources.string: Hands on a table or sofa edge, or knees on the floor
Feet up on a chair

string-array.name: tut_squats_steps
string-array.item: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little.
Sit your hips back and down like onto a low chair, chest up.
Go down until thighs are about parallel to the floor, knees following your toes.
Push through the whole foot to stand up.

string-array.name: tut_squats_avoid
string-array.item: Heels lifting off the floor
Knees caving inward

resources.string: Squat down to touch a chair, then stand
Pause 2 s at the bottom

string-array.name: tut_plank_steps
string-array.item: Forearms on the floor, elbows right under your shoulders, forearms pointing forward.
Step your feet back so your body is a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze glutes and brace your belly like someone is about to poke it.
Look at the floor and keep breathing.

string-array.name: tut_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Hips too high or sagging
Holding your breath

resources.string: Knees on the floor
Lift one foot a few centimetres

string-array.name: tut_glute_bridges_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, heels about a hand away from your bum.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until knees, hips and shoulders are in a line.
Squeeze your glutes for 1 s at the top.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: tut_glute_bridges_avoid
string-array.item: Arching the lower back instead of using glutes
Pushing through the toes

resources.string: Smaller lift
One leg at a time

string-array.name: tut_superman_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down, arms straight forward, legs straight.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor at the same time.
Keep looking at the floor so your neck stays long.
Hold and breathe.

string-array.name: tut_superman_avoid
string-array.item: Cranking the head up to look forward
Lifting so high it pinches the lower back

resources.string: Lift only arms, or only legs
Arms out in a Y shape

string-array.name: tut_reverse_lunges_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step back with one foot.
Lower until both knees are about 90°, back knee just above the floor.
Push through the front heel to step back up. Switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_reverse_lunges_avoid
string-array.item: Front knee caving inward
Leaning the upper body far forward

resources.string: Hold a wall or chair for balance
Wear a loaded backpack

string-array.name: tut_chair_dips_steps
string-array.item: Use a sturdy chair pushed against a wall. Sit on the edge, hands next to your hips, fingers forward.
Slide your bum off the front, feet flat and knees bent.
Bend your elbows straight back until they are about 90°.
Press back up.

string-array.name: tut_chair_dips_avoid
string-array.item: Shoulders shrugging up to the ears
Going so deep it hurts the front of the shoulder

resources.string: Feet closer to the chair
Legs straight

string-array.name: tut_pike_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in so your hips go high — an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor just in front of your hands.
Press back up to the V.

string-array.name: tut_pike_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: Elbows flaring wide
Hips dropping so it turns into a normal push-up

resources.string: Smaller range
Feet up on a chair

string-array.name: tut_hollow_hold_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back. Press your lower back flat into the floor.
Lift your shoulders, arms reaching past your head.
Lift your straight legs a little off the floor — the body makes a shallow banana.
Hold. If your lower back lifts, raise your legs higher.

string-array.name: tut_hollow_hold_avoid
string-array.item: Lower back coming off the floor
Pulling on the neck

resources.string: Bend your knees and tuck them in
Lower arms and legs closer to the floor

string-array.name: tut_wall_sit_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back flat against a wall.
Walk your feet forward and slide down until knees are about 90°.
Knees right above the ankles, arms off your thighs.
Hold and breathe.

string-array.name: tut_wall_sit_avoid
string-array.item: Knees ahead of the toes
Pushing on the thighs with your hands

resources.string: Sit higher on the wall
Lift one foot

string-array.name: tut_mountain_climbers_steps
string-array.item: Start in a high plank: hands under shoulders, body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, like running in place.
Keep your hips level. Each leg counts as one.

string-array.name: tut_mountain_climbers_avoid
string-array.item: Hips bouncing up high
Hands creeping forward

resources.string: Step the feet in slowly, one at a time
Go faster, or drive the knee toward the opposite elbow

string-array.name: tut_burpees_steps
string-array.item: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Jump or step your feet back in.
Jump up with your arms overhead.

string-array.name: tut_burpees_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging in the plank
Landing with stiff legs — land softly

resources.string: Step back and in, no jump
Add a push-up in the plank

string-array.name: tut_pullups_steps
string-array.item: Check the bar is securely mounted. Hang with hands a bit wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Pull your shoulder blades down first.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Lower all the way down slowly.

string-array.name: tut_pullups_avoid
string-array.item: Swinging or kicking for momentum
Half reps that stop short at the bottom

resources.string: Jump up, then lower yourself slowly over 3–5 s
Pause 2 s at the top
